recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source change is recommended for FHIR-16786 unless a future terminology work group review identifies a separate, more specific ValueSet definition/instance ambiguity.
issue_request: FHIR-16786 was a Published/Persuasive, non-substantive Vocab change request from the STU3 cycle asking the ValueSet definition to say "A ValueSet resource instance specifies a set of codes" rather than "A ValueSet resource specifies a set of codes", and more generally to keep the value set resource definition/resource instance distinction clear.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git commit 25cd575210810aef4e6fd1939a51821113bc035e, matching the Jira comment for svn revision 14727. That commit changed the ValueSet spreadsheet definition from "A ValueSet resource specifies" to "A ValueSet resource instances specifies"; commit 3711daf34c0bfd80da9afe8a6c468dcb2cc37d6e shortly afterward corrected the grammar to "A ValueSet resource instance specifies".
additional_context: ValueSet is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini and is mapped to the vocab work group. The current StructureDefinition carries the corrected wording in both the resource description and the ValueSet root element definition. Confluence minutes corroborate the 2018 Vocab block vote, and community/source searches did not reveal conflicting later guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The authoritative current source already satisfies the accepted Jira wording, and the remaining nearby ValueSet narrative uses the definition/resource-instance distinction without reintroducing the original ambiguity.
